evidence_quotes.quote: Weight 3.3 oz (93 g); Dimensions 89 x 54.4 x 17.8 mm; 2.7-inch 64-color display (240 x 400); 32 GB storage; IPX7 waterproof
Battery life up to 17 hours via USB-C rechargeable lithium-ion; Dual-Band GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, Beidou, QZSS)
Supports Shimano Di2 top hood buttons and SRAM AXS Bonus Buttons/Blips for page navigation and lap control alongside gear display

adversarial_checks: Generation separation verified: WFCC6 (ROAM V2, 2022+) has 32 GB storage, Dual-Band GPS, USB-C, 64 colors, and convex buttons — clearly distinct from ROAM V1 (4 GB, micro-USB, 8 colors).
Mount safety check: Explicitly documented Wahoo 90-degree rotated mount tab incompatibility with Garmin pucks to prevent tab shear.
SM-02 check: Verified US $399.99 and KR 560,000 KRW MSRP benchmarks under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null.
